findings.title: Repository guidance omitted new platform role
findings.why_it_matters: Future operators and agents would follow an obsolete Ansible-versus-Argo ownership boundary and miss both the Metrics Server command and its role conventions.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the platform boundary, command list, playbook description, role table, and pinning convention in CLAUDE.md.
evidence: Initial review snapshot: CLAUDE.md said Argo CD owns everything inside the cluster and listed platform.yml as MetalLB plus Traefik only.
